paras: Ancylodactylus laikipiensis, commonly known as the Laikipia pygmy forest gecko, is a species of gecko endemic to Kenya.

Ancylodactylus laikipiensis is known only from the montane forests of the Laikipia Plateau in Kenya, where it can be found in rock crevices, tree trunks, and hollows at 1,600–2,000 m (5,200–6,600 ft) above sea level.
